metadata.description: Mods for Claude Code: two dithered themes, guards for git and files, and two bands above the prompt. Install each one alone.

plugins.name: salt-moon
plugins.description: A dark theme: a dithered salt flat under a pale moon.

plugins.name: salt-moon-dawn
plugins.description: A light theme: the same salt flat at dawn, under a low sun.

plugins.name: commit-guard
plugins.description: Blocks a commit or a pull request text that breaks a rule that you turn on.

plugins.name: push-guard
plugins.description: Asks you before Claude pushes, opens a pull request, or makes a release.

plugins.name: readonly-guard
plugins.description: Keeps folders that you name read only.

plugins.name: delete-guard
plugins.description: Blocks a recursive delete of a folder that Claude did not list first.

plugins.name: style-linter
plugins.description: Blocks em-dashes and emoji in files, and notes passive voice in prose.

plugins.name: commit-size-band
plugins.description: Shows the staged size above the prompt, amber when a commit is too big.

plugins.name: sessions-band
plugins.description: Shows linked sessions and active subagents above the prompt.
